name: Windsor Classic 2017

venue.name: [Georgia Southwestern State University](https://gsw.edu/)
venue.address: 800 Georgia Southwestern State University Drive, Americus, GA 31709

information: The registration fee is $15. There is a 100 person competitor limit with no at-the-door registration. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact me to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: Rubik's Cube, Blindfolded, One-Handed, Feet, Clock and Skewb.
